# Cosmic Truth

> Sovereign, deterministic, Bitcoin-anchored provenance mesh.
> No telemetry. No PII. No commercial rails. All claims are hash-verifiable.

## Doctrine
- Universal Justice Manifesto · Sovereign Runtime Declaration — SHA-256 `8c426dc6…fa45`, anchored Bitcoin block 955889.
- Universal Justice Addendum v1 — SHA-256 `d9b7816a…6834`, OTS submitted to alice/bob/finney calendars 2026-06-29, pending Bitcoin inclusion.

## Architecture
Post-purge (2026-06-30, ops entry #64): strictly Anchor · Verify · Display.
No payment rail, no forge, no investigation module — all non-sovereign standby tiles removed.

Public routes:
- [/](https://cosmictruth.lovable.app/) — landing.
- [/status](https://cosmictruth.lovable.app/status) — real-time node liveness, OTS anchor inclusion, Golden Truth CID state.
- [/digital-ore](https://cosmictruth.lovable.app/digital-ore) — local-only intellectual-byproduct ledger. Hash-deterministic. No payout rail.
- [/truth-coin](https://cosmictruth.lovable.app/truth-coin) — Truth Substrate (TRS) provenance tile.
- [/truth-point](https://cosmictruth.lovable.app/truth-point) — point-of-truth surface.
- [/sudo-coin](https://cosmictruth.lovable.app/sudo-coin) — substrate primer (historical name, retained for link stability).
- [/pam](https://cosmictruth.lovable.app/pam) — SOURCE&TRUTH persona spec.
- [/sam-command](https://cosmictruth.lovable.app/sam-command), [/fleet](https://cosmictruth.lovable.app/fleet), [/gateway](https://cosmictruth.lovable.app/gateway), [/nebula](https://cosmictruth.lovable.app/nebula), [/quantotalus](https://cosmictruth.lovable.app/quantotalus), [/reclaim](https://cosmictruth.lovable.app/reclaim), [/reflective-intel](https://cosmictruth.lovable.app/reflective-intel), [/proof-fulcrum](https://cosmictruth.lovable.app/proof-fulcrum), [/seventh-dimension](https://cosmictruth.lovable.app/seventh-dimension) — doctrine surfaces.

Operator-only (Disallow in robots.txt, excluded from sitemap):

## Boundaries
- No third-party analytics, trackers, or beacons.
- No PII collection. No cookies for tracking.
- No payment processing. DOU is a local-only accounting unit, not currency.
- No legal claim of sovereignty status; doctrine documents are speech, Bitcoin anchors are timestamps.
